sections.body: The Earth spins around like a top. It takes one day (24 hours) to spin once.
When your side faces the Sun, it's DAY. When it faces away, it's NIGHT.
The Earth travels around the Sun. One trip takes a year. The Moon travels around the Earth.
The Sun is a star, the closest one to us!
In a dark room, use a torch as the Sun and a ball as the Earth. Spin the ball slowly to show day and night.

quiz.q: Why do we have day and night?
hints: Is the Sun really turning off?
When you spin on the spot, sometimes you face a lamp and sometimes you don't.
quiz.explain: The Earth spins. Our side faces the Sun (day), then turns away (night).

quiz.q: What does the Moon travel around?
hints: Which one is the Moon's closest neighbour?
We see the Moon from our planet every month.
Mars has two small moons that travel around Mars. Our Moon travels around our own planet. Which planet is ours?
quiz.explain: The Moon travels around the Earth.
